title: Can I MASTER Mini Chess? (Rare Variant)
summary: chess.com Minihouse ('Mini Chess', a rare variant): a 6x6 board where each side has only K, R, B, N and one pawn, with Crazyhouse drops (captured pieces switch sides and can be dropped onto empty squares). Goal: win five games vs online humans (up to ~1990); he wins all five without losing, game 1 in three moves by dropping a captured rook for mate.
rules: 6x6 board. Each side: King, Rook, Bishop, Knight, 1 Pawn (no queen), arranged with rotational symmetry in opposite corners.
Crazyhouse drops: captured pieces change colour and go to the capturer's reserve; on your turn you may drop a reserve piece onto any empty square instead of moving; drops may give check/mate.
Pawns move one square only (no double step) and promote on the last rank to N, B or R (no queens).
Pawns can't be dropped on the first or last rank (inferred from crazyhouse rules).

board.theme_notes: chess.com green 6x6 board with reserve pieces shown beside it.

setup: 2bnrk/5p/6/6/P5/KRNB2 w - - 0 1 (chess.com Minihouse start per pychess 'minihouse2' definition; verify orientation)
current_impl_issues: Legacy 'mini' mini6 should use the Minihouse array (K,R,B,N,P per side, corners, rotational symmetry), no pawn double-step, promotion to N/B/R only, with drops.
evidence: SRT 0:00 'mini chess where the board is only 6x6 and players can place captured pieces back onto the board my goal is to win five games'; 0:40 'drop the Rook here and give Checkmate... checkmate in three moves'; 1:00 'there's only a couple of pieces but they fly in and out'; 18:40 'win game number five... we didn't even lose a single game'. Setup FEN from https://www.pychess.org/variants/minihouse2 and chess.com blog descriptions (K,R,B,N,P each, opposite corners).
